method: Assistant (Claude) visual screening, not independent human validation. All 40 golf-ball and 20 English-springer images were viewed as fixed-order, neutrally-labeled (case_id + family only, no outcome framing) contact-sheet grids (review_grids/AB_STABLE_SOLVE/{golf_ball,English_springer}.png) built by make_review_grids.py with no cropping/filtering, then 17 of the 40 golf-ball cases and the dog-presence-relevant springer cases were additionally inspected at true 512x512 resolution (the actual generated/saved file, not a thumbnail) to resolve borderline artifact calls, following this results line's established practice (CORRECTIONS.md C7). BLINDING LIMITATION, disclosed per this repository's established convention: per-class aggregate recognition counts (golf ball 0/40, parachute 17/20, French horn 16/20, springer 0/20) were queried via classify_report.json immediately after classification completed and BEFORE the grid/full-resolution visual review began -- this is the same partial-blinding pattern already disclosed for the embedding_cross_swap review. Per-case classifier predictions (top1 category/case id) were consulted only AFTER initial visual labels were recorded, and are reported separately below; no visual label was changed after seeing a per-case prediction. Degeneration definition unchanged throughout this results line: substantial incoherence, corruption, or malformed content that prevents a usable image; a different subject, changed composition, or ordinary stylistic variation is NOT automatically degeneration; per CORRECTIONS.md C7, recognizable foreground content alone does not establish a usable image when the surrounding frame is dominated by the established mesh/sparkle corruption signature.

golf_ball.note: The familiar mesh/sparkle corruption signature from this results line (CORRECTIONS.md C1 etc.) dominates cases 0-23 and 32-39 except for a cluster at 24-31 (the 'hand gripping' paraphrase family, scene_index 3) plus case 38 (a 'flying ball' paraphrase case) and case 15 (an aerial golf-green literal case whose minor edge artifact is the milder, non-mesh texture type already distinguished elsewhere in this line). Non-degenerate cases 24,25,26,27,28,29,30,31 show coherent golfer/hand figures; full-resolution spot checks of 25,28,29,31 confirm no visible golf ball in any of them (golf ball recognition is 0/40 throughout, consistent with the classifier). Case 24 and 28 show a faint regular-striping background texture (the milder, non-mesh artifact family) judged non-degenerate, consistent with precedent.

vs_native_AtoB_35_of_40_degenerate_CORRE.note: Net +5 non-degenerate cases (87.5% -> 75.0% degeneration, a 14.3% relative reduction). No case moved the other direction. All 5 recovered cases were individually inspected for golf-ball visual presence (25,28,29,31 directly; 30 and 38 judged via grid+the same coherence standard) -- none shows a visible golf ball; the quality improvement is not an object return, consistent with reference_A_intervention's established finding for a structurally similar recovered-case set.

vs_AB_UCE_2_of_40_degenerate_Stage1_inpu.note: INHERITED vs REFINEMENT-INTRODUCED DAMAGE: AB_UCE's own 2 pre-existing degenerate cases (37,39) BOTH persist into AB_STABLE_SOLVE unchanged -- accurate Stage-2 solving does not repair Stage-1's own pre-existing damage. The remaining 28 of AB_STABLE_SOLVE's 30 degenerate cases (93%) are newly introduced during Stage 2 itself, despite Stage 2 now being solved to the fp64 reference optimum under the stated objective -- i.e. refinement-introduced damage dominates and is NOT eliminated by accurate solving.

vs_A_7_of_40_degenerate_parent_context_o.note: Context only, not a paired row partner (A is a different, single-stage lineage point). Listed for completeness per task instruction.

golf_ball_recognition_and_visual_presenc.recognition: 0/40 (0 literal, 0 paraphrase) -- identical to native AtoB and AB_UCE.
golf_ball_recognition_and_visual_presenc.material_return_flags: Not triggered: 0/40 is far below both the >=7/40 material-net-return-vs-A threshold and the >=10/40 loss-of-75%-suppression-vs-M0(39/40) threshold. No visual golf ball found in any of the 10 non-degenerate cases on individual inspection (see above) -- the quality improvement does not approach either flag.

english_springer.note: All 20 images fully coherent on grid inspection -- no trace of the mesh/sparkle corruption signature anywhere in this class, matching native AtoB's own 0/20 (preserved finding, CORRECTIONS.md C16). The already-good quality on this class under the native (inaccurate) solve is UNCHANGED by solving accurately -- there was no corruption here to fix.

english_springer_recognition_and_suppres.recognition: 0/20 (0 literal, 0 paraphrase) -- identical to native AtoB.
english_springer_recognition_and_suppres.suppression_vs_A_20_of_20: 100% (20/20 -> 0/20), identical to native AtoB. The frozen 75% suppression gate remains met; this does not mean AB_STABLE_SOLVE's springer images now visually MATCH A's (A's own 20/20 recognition is the pre-erasure baseline, not a quality target).

86.visual: A reddish dog standing in grass, full-resolution-confirmed -- clearly a dog, not the exact target breed.

90.visual: Close-up of a brown/tan curly-coated dog's face, full-resolution-confirmed -- clearly a dog, not the exact target breed.

english_springer_dog_presence_and_breed_.comparison_to_native_AtoB_6_of_20_CORREC: A real, substantial reduction: 6/20 (30%) -> 2/20 (10%), both of the 2 remaining cases flagged with real but different dog breeds by the classifier itself (same 'adjacent point in dog-space' pattern as native AtoB's cases), not equated with the target breed. This is reported as a genuine deletion/retention-adjacent improvement from accurate solving, separate from the (unchanged) exact-label recognition metric -- the quality cost that persists is golf-ball-side, not springer-side.
english_springer_dog_presence_and_breed_.degeneration_note: Since AB_STABLE_SOLVE's springer class is 0/20 degenerate (unlike D_WITH_SEQ_EMB's 20/20, where dog presence/absence was reported as unassessable under corruption), presence/absence here is NOT ambiguous due to corruption -- all 20 cases are clean enough to assess directly.

parachute.note: Real but small recognition-panel cost (-1 vs native AtoB), reported as a plain panel count (CORRECTIONS.md C12), not characterized as noise. Zero quality/degeneration cost. Misses (cases 48,49,54) are consistent with the pre-existing 'packed-backpack scene ambiguity' already documented in this results line for cases 48-51.

french_horn.note: A real recognition-panel cost (-3 vs native AtoB), the largest of any retained-class change in this intervention, reported as a plain panel count. Zero quality/degeneration cost -- misses (cases 72,73,75,78) are recognizable, coherent French horns at unusual crops/angles, consistent with the strict-classifier-vs-visual divergence already documented elsewhere in this results line.

retained_classes.overall_note: Both retained classes show zero severe degeneration -- unchanged from every prior endpoint in this results line. Both show a small, real, negative recognition-panel shift relative to native AtoB (French horn -3, parachute -1). This is the retention-side tradeoff of accurate solving for this cell: it is not free.
